ViewProject patch: manual modal positioning — iOS doesn't layer
Sourcesrc/core/safari/patches/view-project.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

patchViewProject

Installs the view-project Safari patch once the element registers: replaces _updateModalDOM with the lifted-dialog variant and wraps onDestroy so a modal lifted into document.body is reaped when the view unmounts (otherwise it orphans on top of the next page). onMounted is wrapped to inject the safari-internals stylesheet — WebKit does not reliably unskip content-visibility: auto subtrees, so the internal sections render eagerly on Safari only.
